001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CGMAlertStatusResponse;
007import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CgmStatusV2Response;
008
009@HistoryLogProps(
010    opCode = 371,
011    displayName = "CGM Alert Ack B",
012    internalName = "LID_CGM_ALERT_ACK_B"
013)
014public class CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
015
016    private int alertId;
017    private CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert alert;
018    private int sensorType;
019    private long ackSource;
020
021    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog() {}
022    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int alertId, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
023        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
024        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, alertId, sensorType, ackSource);
025        this.alertId = alertId;
026        this.alert = CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert.fromId(alertId);
027        this.sensorType = sensorType;
028        this.ackSource = ackSource;
029
030    }
031
032    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert alert, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
033        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, alert != null ? alert.id() : 0, sensorType, ackSource);
034        this.alert = alert;
035
036    }
037
038    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog(int alertId, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
039        this(0, 0, alertId, sensorType, ackSource);
040    }
041
042    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog(CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert alert, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
043        this(0, 0, alert, sensorType, ackSource);
044    }
045
046    public int typeId() {
047        return 371;
048    }
049
050    /**
051     * <table border="1">
052     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog:</caption>
053     * <tr><td><code>alertId</code></td><td><code>raw[10]</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>alert</code></td><td><code>CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert.fromId(alertId)</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>sensorType</code></td><td><code>raw[11]</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>ackSource</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
057     * </table>
058     */
059    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
060        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
061        this.cargo = raw;
062        parseBase(raw);
063        this.alertId = raw[10];
064        this.alert = CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert.fromId(alertId);
065        this.sensorType = raw[11];
066        this.ackSource = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
067
068    }
069
070    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int alertId, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
071        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
072            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(371, 0),
073            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
074            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
075            new byte[]{ (byte) alertId },
076            new byte[]{ (byte) sensorType },
077            new byte[2],
078            Bytes.toUint32(ackSource)));
079    }
080
081    public int getAlertId() {
082        return alertId;
083    }
084
085    public CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert getAlert() {
086        return alert;
087    }
088
089    /**
090     * The type of glucose sensor which raised the alert, as a CGMSensorType ordinal (see
091     * {@link #getSensorTypeEnum()}). Tandem's export schema lists 0 = Invalid, 1 = Dexcom G6 and
092     * 3 = Dexcom G7 for this opcode. Every captured record has 3, all from Dexcom G7 sessions.
093     */
094    public int getSensorType() {
095        return sensorType;
096    }
097
098    public CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType getSensorTypeEnum() {
099        return CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType.fromId(sensorType);
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * What acknowledged the alert, per Tandem's export schema: 0 = acknowledged by the user,
104     * 1 = acknowledged by software (see {@link AckSource}). Both values occur in captured records.
105     */
106    public long getAckSource() {
107        return ackSource;
108    }
109
110    public AckSource getAckSourceEnum() {
111        return AckSource.fromId(ackSource);
112    }
113
114    public enum AckSource {
115        USER(0),
116        SOFTWARE(1),
117
118        ;
119        private final long id;
120        AckSource(long id) {
121            this.id = id;
122        }
123
124        public static AckSource fromId(long id) {
125            for (AckSource a : values()) {
126                if (a.id == id) {
127                    return a;
128                }
129            }
130            return null;
131        }
132
133        public long getId() {
134            return id;
135        }
136    }
137}
